conclusion: Existing immutable registration seed plus nonwrapping software session/controller generation can label a held software receipt. No reviewed scalar alone proves native ownership, node-allocation uniqueness or full native cleanup. Bind actual publication and whole-return ingress to the same immutable receipt; transitive owning source remains explicitly unclosed.

rows.name: FIFO generation and slot ticket
rows.producer: Base memory_output_submit refuses generation==0x1fffffff, increments under metadata exclusion and publishes COPYING then READY after copied data. Positive ticket is explicitly private, never native client ID.
rows.consumer: find(ticket), register admission and continuous FIFO reader validate exact slot.ticket; slot index is low two bits.
rows.change_or_clear: configure preserves generation; discard/read/cancel_ready free slot but do not decrease generation. Same slot may next carry a different ticket. BSS reload persistence is not established.
rows.publication_cleanup_eligibility: FIFO/body correlation only. A live slot check cannot be required for a persistent source after complete copied PCM consumption.

rows.name: output.active_ticket
rows.producer: Base memory_output_register assigns the ticket before calling original registration; full original return updates status. A failure with empty native list/nonbusy record clears it; uncertain publication stays pinned.
rows.consumer: Guard queue permit/capture/pull require it equals registration_ticket; loaded reader treats source-live status separately from current FIFO head.
rows.change_or_clear: Base memory_output_release clears it only after idle node/record/mixer/method/provider and no in-flight checks plus caller's complete native cleanup/list-return barrier.
rows.publication_cleanup_eligibility: Stable software registration label within the held BSS instance, not a node-generation or native owner certificate. Loaded wrapper includes an unreviewed owner TU, so exact base-to-loaded semantic identity is a dependency gap.

rows.name: guard.registration_ticket
rows.producer: mcs_register_begin admits a READY copied ticket while owned generation is armed and no prior seed/session/callback mutation exists; successful mcs_register_end stores permit_ticket only if original result0, consumed permit and active_ticket match.
rows.consumer: Source handoff, selector capture, full pulls and reader admission require nonzero seed. aas_registration_seed exposes it. No selected-phase guard looks up the seed's old FIFO slot.
rows.change_or_clear: register_end clears permit transient fields; registration_ticket remains unchanged by FIFO reads. Successful scoped session release and scoped guard release clear it.
rows.publication_cleanup_eligibility: Usable as a software receipt label paired with guard context/session/controller generation, after publication provenance is bound. It is not sufficient alone for whole native cleanup, ownership or native allocation uniqueness across reload.

rows.name: continuous coordinator.ticket versus finite coordinator.ticket
rows.producer: Both register_head helpers set ticket before calling memory_output_register. It may therefore exist before a successful native publication. Current Source first-start path calls aas_register directly and records mh_ticket per PCM cycle, not coordinator state.
rows.consumer: Continuous pump retains its initial ticket once set; finite pump compares/retires each buffer and advances to next. Old adapter publication uses coordinator.ticket as token.
rows.change_or_clear: Continuous clears only after stop/remove and memory_output_release success; finite clears after per-buffer owned_media_release. Error paths can leave coordinator.ticket without active native publication.
rows.publication_cleanup_eligibility: Conditional correlation only. A nonzero coordinator.ticket is not proof of successful publication; old adapter preconditions cannot be transplanted into loaded Source path using this field alone.

rows.name: anchor address
rows.type: static uint16_t anchor_zero address; guard.anchor uint32_t
rows.producer: Base owning TU defines anchor_zero; registration params[3] borrows its address with two-byte extent. Driver obtains an anchor through native_ui_music_owned_anchor_address and mcs_init stores caller value.
rows.consumer: Queue permit checks params anchor identity; native_binding_matches compares selected pool data pointer against g.anchor. Base release scans pool references against its own anchor.
rows.change_or_clear: Address is stable for this owning TU/module lifetime; same address can be reused for later source sessions or after reload. Getter implementation lives in the unreviewed transitive owner file.
rows.publication_cleanup_eligibility: Content identity/provenance field only. Not a unique allocation/session ID, nor whole-cleanup token by itself.

rows.name: native source record / list and node count
rows.type: caller record pointer; uint16_t node count; native key0xffff
rows.producer: Driver takes record/pool parameters; known Source path passes its channel8 record/pool constants. Original queue registration mutates list/native record; selected code observes count and fields, not an allocation generation.
rows.consumer: Queue dispatch requires list==source_record+0x1a8 and native key0xffff; base register checks node_count; capture checks record busy/F0/method and pool binding. Old cleanup compares exact record pointer.
rows.change_or_clear: Record/list address fixed by channel, while contents/profile/methods can be rebuilt. Node count changes with original queue/remove; count1 only reports cardinality.
rows.publication_cleanup_eligibility: No native node pointer/allocation serial is recovered in selected captures. Record address, count1 and key0xffff are not unique source tokens. Full native producer/allocator ABI remains unproved.

rows.name: selected_instance and continuous_anchor_instance
rows.producer: Native original selector/factory writes record+0xf0; guard reads it only after selector completion and validates busy/method/anchor fields. Loaded bind copies guard index to continuous_anchor_instance.
rows.consumer: Pool instance selects method/read admission; full pull frame captures index and verifies it against current binding.
rows.change_or_clear: Guard init/release set selected_instance UINT32_MAX. Successful rebind may write same index again; original pool index can be recycled. No monotonic native allocation epoch field is tested.
rows.publication_cleanup_eligibility: Useful selected-binding field, never an ABA-proof native allocation identity. Native allocator generation not recovered in this source family.

rows.name: guard epoch and selected_session
rows.type: uint32_t software session epoch / selected-session latch
rows.producer: mcs_reserve_scoped owner/normal-context checks, state/generation matching and UINT32_MAX overflow guard increment epoch after assigning held generation. Actual selected capture latches session==epoch.
rows.consumer: Selector bind/release APIs take session; handoff and pull frames compare session/epoch/controller generation. aas_session_id returns selected_session.
rows.change_or_clear: selected_session clears after successful native release or stopped scoped release; epoch is not cleared/decremented there. BSS/module reload persistence is an external contract.
rows.publication_cleanup_eligibility: Best existing software session discriminator within a pinned guard lifetime. It supplies correlation with the controller generation and actual binding checks, but not native all-writer ownership/full-cleanup evidence.

rows.name: controller generation and admission epoch
rows.producer: umc_request_start increments both with overflow guards, blocks nonidle/nonstopped or active service/leases and clears source_seen/token/cleanup_seen. Stop invalidates admission separately.
rows.consumer: Guard copies controller generation; typed source_started/cleanup_returned match same route/generation/cookie. Borrow leases capture admission/current generation.
rows.change_or_clear: Generation remains current through Stop; successful next Start increments and clears publication state. Module initialization clears controller before publication only; not a durable reload counter.
rows.publication_cleanup_eligibility: Generation is a necessary controller-cycle key, not native node identity. Admission epoch is access revocation, not source token or ownership witness epoch.

rows.name: ownership cookie and Source actor
rows.type: config uint32_t cookie; Source TCB identity
rows.producer: Driver config captures current_actor and hardcodes cookie0x1352/resident-confirmed1. Guard owner copies configured Source TCB; coordinator independently captures current TCB at init.
rows.consumer: Owner-only reserve/register/mutation compare actual current actor. Old witness provider must match generation/cookie/channel/owner/source_token and nonzero witness epoch with exclusion flags.
rows.change_or_clear: Cookie/config Source actor do not change in these objects after init. TCB addresses may recycle or storage reload; no allocation epoch tied to TCB is provided here.
rows.publication_cleanup_eligibility: Actor constraint and caller-declared cookie fields only. Fixed HWID-shaped cookie is not ownership; this review does not invent a replacement cookie or derive exclusivity from current TCB.

rows.name: mixer capability tuple
rows.producer: Source handoff reads original mixer metadata; checks distinct owner, stack/descriptor/current queue and scoped generation before storing tuple.
rows.consumer: actual_mixer_actor uses capability match; selector/full pull require actual mixer actor and exact C-supplied caller return provenance values.
rows.change_or_clear: mismatch revokes mixer_session; pull/reader binding replacement revokes. Scoped release does not clear mixer_tcb/stack/queue fields; a later handoff in same guard requires !mixer_tcb and is not shown reusable.
rows.publication_cleanup_eligibility: Scoped source→mixer capability, explicitly not native exclusive-owner certificate. It binds actor provenance but does not mint source node generation or full cleanup receipt.

evidence.function: fields cleared by scoped release (loaded-family copied guard)

rows.name: full pull receipt
rows.producer: mcs_pull_begin captures the current tuple before original native descriptor/index load, under metadata exclusion and with typed leases.
rows.consumer: reader_admit compares frozen frame identity to current guard/native binding and active registration seed. mcs_pull_end only records if same frame/actor remains.
rows.change_or_clear: Full pull end marks original_returned and clears borrow before lease releases. This is a full-pull return receipt, not Source native cleanup or STOP_DONE.
rows.publication_cleanup_eligibility: Concrete existing matched borrowed-frame identity usable for pull lifetime. It cannot supply cleanup_returned without a distinct complete cleanup ingress and frozen publication token.

rows.name: core source_token consumer
rows.type: opaque nonzero uint32_t supplied by typed caller
rows.producer: umc_source_started stores caller token after same_source checks; it does not allocate or discover a native token.
rows.consumer: umc_cleanup_returned requires the exact stored token and same generation/route/cookie; stop_complete additionally requires complete cancel/remove/release/quiet evidence.
rows.change_or_clear: Start resets token0. A different token while source_seen and not cleaned is rejected; cleanup only sets cleanup_seen, does not itself finish Stop.
rows.publication_cleanup_eligibility: The core can consume a proven software receipt label; it cannot make one authoritative. No automatic numeric conversion from epoch/ticket/record or new constant is proposed.

rows.name: old publication/cleanup trace token
rows.type: trace source_token/generation/ownership_epoch; cleanup frame immutable copy
rows.producer: Old publication helper obtains coordinator ticket+active output+live matching slot and witness, stores trace and invokes started. Cleanup begin holds callback lease then copies trace token/generation/cookie/route and record address.
rows.consumer: Cleanup after_original matches captured record/current trace and forwards typed cleaned; original completion callback is still forwarded while callback lease held.
rows.change_or_clear: Old prepare clears trace token before start; new publication clears original_cleanup_returned and saves count baselines. Original cleanup-return flag marks only after supplied complete-return helper invocation.
rows.publication_cleanup_eligibility: An existing design for publication↔cleanup correlation, but old live-slot producer and unrecovered ownership_snapshot do not match continuous loaded source automatically. No actual loaded notification callsite is established; original ASM bridge not read/executed.

rows.name: loaded session release versus old ticket release
rows.type: session API uint32_t; old ticket API deliberately rejected
rows.producer: Loaded wrapper owns scoped register/bind/read/release entrypoints. Successful release_session captures legacy seed, calls original owner release under native mutation, then clears selected_session/instance/registration_ticket.
rows.consumer: Current wrapper rejects memory_output_after_selection(ticket) and memory_output_release(ticket). Base continuous coordinator still calls old release(ticket); actual linked Source path instead lacks complete controller cancel/observe providers here.
rows.change_or_clear: Seed is read before original release and cleared only after result0. For a cleanup receipt, it must be captured before possible clearing and retained until actual full original return/notification.
rows.publication_cleanup_eligibility: A direct unadapted base coordinator→loaded-wrapper retirement call is incompatible. This is a source-contract join condition, not evidence the actual loaded image executes that join. Unknown generated/relinked caller cannot be assumed. The session release requires selected_session==epoch; a native queue published before selection needs explicit retirement handling, not the never-published barrier.

rows.name: transitive owning implementation closure
rows.producer: Loaded owning wrapper includes memory_output_owner.c after renaming private original APIs. That included owner source was not in this scope's fixed two-file capture.
rows.consumer: Wrapper calls renamed original register/read/release and private lock/record/buffer facilities; base continuous memory_output.c is reviewed separately.
rows.change_or_clear: Exact source inclusion/hash equivalence and getter definition must be pinned before claiming loaded origin semantics. No fresh source added after fixed capture.
rows.publication_cleanup_eligibility: Explicit unclosed dependency. Include text names the owner TU but does not prove its whole body equals the base source or exact emitted image; no ELF/native import/compile performed.

highest_available_correlator.status: software correlation tuple; not a native ownership certificate or implemented persistent provider

native_node_allocation_generation_scope: Selected C/H captures only; no original allocator/ASM/firmware/RAM scan. Software generation/session fields are separately identified.
